title: X Pixel
content:
# X Pixel

Read and create the X Pixel, manage its conversion events, check they are tracking and install it on Shopify or WordPress.

import { Tab, Tabs } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

The X Pixel is the ad account's universal website tag, managed through the platform-neutral [tracking tags API](/guides/pixels) on your `xads` account. X allows one per ad account.

## Read the tag

`GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/tracking-tags/{tagId}` returns the pixel, its base code and its conversion events. `tagId` is the X ad account id.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `tagId` | The X ad account id (for example `18ce54d4x5t`) |
| `siteTagId` | The pixel id (the universal website tag's id), what `twq('config')` loads |
| `events` | The account's conversion events (web event tags), without the ones X auto-creates with the pixel |

Each event has `type` (`PURCHASE`, `ADD_TO_CART`, ...), `status`, `clickWindowDays`, `viewWindowDays` and `siteEventId`. `siteEventId` is `tw-<pixel>-<event>`, the id `twq('event')` and the Conversions API send.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data } = await zernio.trackingtags.getTrackingTag({
  path: { accountId: '66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d', tagId: '18ce54d4x5t' }
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
data = client.tracking_tags.get_tracking_tag(
    account_id="66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    tag_id="18ce54d4x5t",
)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/accounts/66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d/tracking-tags/18ce54d4x5t" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`200`):

```json
{
  "platform": "xads",
  "tag": {
    "id": "18ce54d4x5t",
    "siteTagId": "o8z1q",
    "name": "X Pixel o8z1q",
    "platform": "xads",
    "kind": "pixel",
    "status": "active",
    "code": "<!-- X conversion tracking base code -->\n<script>...twq('config','o8z1q');</script>",
    "lastFiredTime": 1804150800,
    "installed": true,
    "ownerAdAccountId": "18ce54d4x5t",
    "events": [
      { "id": "14cgjq", "siteEventId": "tw-o8z1q-rg1cq", "name": "Purchase", "type": "PURCHASE", "status": "TRACKING", "siteEvent": "purchase", "clickWindowDays": 30, "viewWindowDays": 1 }
    ]
  }
}
```

`status` is `active` when any of the account's web event tags is `TRACKING`. `lastFiredTime` is the most recent `last_tracked_at` across them.

## Pixel operations

| Operation | Behavior |
|-----------|----------|
| List | One pixel per ad account on the connection; `adAccountId` scopes it to one. |
| Stats (`GET .../stats`) | One row per web event tag with `eventId`, `name`, `type`, `autoCreated`, `status` and `lastTrackedTime`. |
| Create (`POST .../tracking-tags`) | Creates the ad account's pixel (`adAccountId` = the X ad account id) with first-party cookies on. `name` is not stored, since X pixels have no name. |
| Update (`PATCH .../tracking-tags/{tagId}`) | `firstPartyCookieStatus` only: `first_party_cookie_enabled` or `first_party_cookie_disabled` (the pixel's `allow_1p_cookie`). `empty` answers `400`. |
| Share | `501`: an X Pixel belongs to exactly one ad account, and X has no share endpoint (`/pixels`, `/event_sources` and `/universal_website_tags` answer `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`). |
| Diagnostics, users and partners | `501`. |
| Delete | Not offered: `DELETE /12/accounts/:id/website_tags/:id` answers `405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, and X's reference and Ads SDKs have no delete. |

X exposes no per-pixel or per-event counts in its reference, only `WEB_CONVERSION` metrics on each ad and campaign.

## Conversion events

`.../tracking-tags/{tagId}/events` lists, creates, updates and deletes the conversion events.

| Field | Values |
|-------|--------|
| `name` | The event's name |
| `type` or `siteEvent` | X's event type, such as `PURCHASE`, `SIGN_UP` or `CUSTOM`, or the site event it maps from |
| `clickWindowDays` | 1, 7, 14, 30, 60 or 90 |
| `viewWindowDays` | 0, 1, 7, 14, 30, 60 or 90, no longer than the click window when both are sent |

A create defaults to 30 and 1 days with retargeting on, as Events Manager does, and is not idempotent. Delete is permanent (`state: "deleted"`).

The events X auto-creates with the pixel share its id, so a site cannot fire them one by one. They are left out of the list, and changing or deleting one answers `400`.

## Install on a site

`POST .../tracking-tags/{tagId}/install` puts the pixel on a connected [Shopify](/platforms/shopify/tracking-pixels) store or [WordPress](/platforms/wordpress/tracking-pixels) site.

**WordPress** gets X's `uwt.js` base code, whose `twq('config')` is the page view.

**Shopify** sends the page view and each event that has a matching conversion event to `analytics.twitter.com/1/i/adsct`. When several match a type, the most recently tracked one wins.

Shopify events use `uwt.js`'s own request shape, which is reverse-engineered: X documents only the legacy image pixel.

`conversion_id` is the event id, so X deduplicates against the Conversions API, and the `twclid` click id stays first-party.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `400` on a per-tag call | The ad account has no pixel | Create one with `POST .../tracking-tags`. |
| `409` on a create | The ad account already has a pixel; X allows one and cannot delete it | Read the existing pixel instead. |
| `400` on an event update or delete | The event is one X auto-created with the pixel | Leave it; create your own event instead. |
| `501` with code `platform_not_supported` | Share, diagnostics, users or partners | The message names the alternative. |
